body.text: Mosquitoes are very dangerous. They kill about 72,000 people a year. About 3,200 kinds of mosquitoes live on Earth. About 200 of them bite people, and only females bite. How do mosquitoes find people? They smell our breath and sweat. When we exercise, we sweat. We breathe out more air. Then, the mosquitoes find and bite us. They take our blood. Also, heavy people and children get more mosquito bites. Usually, heavy people breathe out more air. And children sweat more than adults. Look around you. Can you see any mosquitoes? Catch them before they bite you.
